Founded on the principle of turning waste into value, the company's motto — 'from disaster to design' — reflects its start in repurposing dead and dying urban trees into usable lumber and finished goods.
The sawmill produces custom furniture, timber art, fireplace mantels, benches, chairs, and tables, often incorporating metal accents.
Facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not publicly disclosed.
Customers range from homeowners seeking one-of-a-kind pieces for homes, cabins, and campgrounds to municipal and commercial clients needing arborist and forestry services.
Urban milling services target property owners and municipalities looking for sustainable alternatives to chipping or hauling logs.
The founder's emphasis on using 'everything we have right here where we are' underscores a hyper-local, waste-to-product model.
